sentences.en: A straight line is a trivial example of a curve.
sentences.zh: 一条直线是曲线的一个平凡例子。

sentences.en: Sami told Layla that his relationship with Salima was trivial.
sentences.zh: 萨米告诉莱拉他与萨利玛的关系很普通。

sentences.en: They ended up having a massive fight over something trivial.
sentences.zh: 他们因为一些琐事大吵了一架。

senses.zh: 琐碎的，无足轻重的：little importance
